response.sql: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg WHERE avg_feerate IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank_in_scope FROM above) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope
